name: assign-serviceaccount-to-pod-v1

attributes.m$K8sThreatMatrix: Privilege Escalation::Assign service account to a controlled pod

description: determines which subjects can create pods, or create/update/patch pod controllers such as Deployments, DaemonSets and Jobs, in privileged namespaces, letting them attach a service account of their choosing to a pod they control and indirectly inherit its permissions
remediation: Avoid granting create on pods or write access to pod controllers in kube-system and other privileged namespaces. Where a subject must manage workloads, confine it to an unprivileged namespace that contains no admin-equivalent service accounts.
